ns2:section.sectionText: This course examines the myths of Greece and Rome, with special emphasis being placed on their cultural contexts (both social and literary), interpretation, and influence throughout the art and literature of western civilization. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
